# Blank identifier parameters are renamed to _p0, _p1, ... to avoid a gotip
# GOEXPERIMENT=simd compiler bug where _ params in simd-using functions produce
# "cannot use _ as value or type".

cp ops.go ops.go.orig
loopvec -split .
! stdout .
cmpenv stderr stderr.want
cmp ops_simd.go ops_simd.go.want
cmp ops.go ops.go.guarded

-- go.mod --
module example.com/test

go 1.27.1
-- ops.go --
package test

func FillZeroBlankParams(_ int, _ byte, dst []float32) {
	for i := range dst {
		dst[i] = 0
	}
}
-- ops_simd.go.want --
//go:build goexperiment.simd

package test

import "simd"

func FillZeroBlankParams(_p0 int, _p1 byte, dst []float32) {
	_vcFloat32s0 := simd.BroadcastFloat32s(0)
	for _i := 0; _i < len(dst); {
		_n := _vcFloat32s0.StorePart(dst[_i:])
		_i += _n
	}
}
-- stderr.want --
loopvec: rewrote 1 loop(s) in $WORK/ops.go
-- ops.go.guarded --
//go:build !goexperiment.simd

package test

func FillZeroBlankParams(_ int, _ byte, dst []float32) {
	for i := range dst {
		dst[i] = 0
	}
}
